summary: Hamilton's Ferrari resurges into pole position for the first time in over three years, challenging Verstappen's dominance as the championship fight intensifies at Mexico City's high-altitude circuit. Verstappen and Lawson carry grid penalties from Friday's practice collision, shuffling the midfield equation and handing opportunity to Haas's debutant Ryo Hirakawa to capitalize on the chaos. A Hamilton victory combined with strategic results ahead would dramatically tighten the title race with just seven races remaining on the calendar.
